Benefits vary by status tier.Explore our cardsPremium travel benefitsCiti® / AAdvantage® Globe™ cardFor your travel needsCiti® / AAdvantage® Platinum Select® cardFor businessCiti® / AAdvantage Business™ cardNo annual feeAAdvantage® MileUp® cardFAQsWhat rewards does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card offer?The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® offers cardmembers the ability to earn:
4 AAdvantage® miles for every $1 spent on eligible American Airlines purchases.2
12 AAdvantage® miles for every $1 spent on eligible hotels booked through aadvantagehotels.com and eligible car rentals booked through aadvantagecars.com.2
1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases.2
After you spend $150,000 in purchases in a calendar year, you may earn a total of 5 AAdvantage® miles for every $1 spent on eligible American Airlines purchases for the remainder of the year2
How can I redeem my AAdvantage® miles earned with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card?Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive cardmembers can redeem their AAdvantage® miles for a variety of exciting travel rewards, such as:
Flights to nearly 1,000 destinations across the globe
Upgrades on most domestic and international flights marketed and operated by American Airlines
Hotels in over 500 destinations worldwide, car rentals and more
What travel benefits does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card offer?The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card gives you access to a suite of benefits that heightens the travel experience, including:
Admirals Club® membership2
First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries (for you and up to 8 companions on the same reservation)2
Up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit every 4 years2
Travel Protection Benefits: Trip Delay Protection, Trip Cancellation & Interruption Protection, Worldwide Car Rental Insurance and Lost Baggage Protection2
Up to $100 back on inflight and eligible Admirals Club® purchases every calendar year2
Up to $500 back on eligible American Airlines Vacations℠ purchases every calendar year2
What additional benefits does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card offer?
Up to $120 back on eligible prepaid Avis® and Budget car rentals every calendar year2
Up to $180 in Lyft credits (after taking 3 eligible rides in a calendar month, earn a $15 Lyft credit, for a total of up to $180 in Lyft credits annually)2
How can I earn Loyalty Points with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card?You will earn 1 Loyalty Point toward AAdvantage® status for every eligible AAdvantage® mile you earn with your Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card.
You may earn a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching 50,000, 90,000, 165,000 and 240,000 Loyalty Points in the same status qualification year.2Do you get a statement credit for TSA PreCheck® or Global Entry with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card?
Yes, you’ll receive a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® application fee credit of up to $120 every 4 years.2
Is the first checked bag free with the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card?
As a Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive cardmember, your first checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 8 travel companions listed on the same reservation.2
How many Admirals Club® lounges can I access with the card?
The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card gives you access to more than 100 Admirals Club® lounges and partner lounges worldwide.2
How many companions can I bring into the Admirals Club® ?
The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card gives access for the primary cardmember and up to 2 guests or immediate family members.2
How does the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card help me reach AAdvantage status faster?
The Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive Card supports earning Loyalty Points toward AAdvantage® status, which can help you move closer to qualifying levels as you use the card.
The primary cardmember can earn a 10,000 Loyalty Point bonus after reaching 50,000, 90,000, 165,000 and 240,000 Loyalty Points in the same status qualification year.2
What benefits do I get with Omni Hotels?
Primary cardmembers are eligible to enroll in Omni Hotels and Resorts Champion Status. Enjoy unique perks such as early check-in, late check-out and room upgrades (subject to availability). Additionally, once per calendar year, primary cardmembers can earn an Omni Free Night Award after completing a stay of two or more consecutive nights at a hotel booked directly through Omni Hotels and Resorts on omnihotels.com. Enrollment into the Champion Status benefit is required.2
How does the $500 American Airlines Vacations℠ credit work?
The American Airlines Vacations℠ credit is broken up into 2 earning periods. You may earn up to a $250 statement credit on eligible American Airlines Vacations purchases made January through June and up to $250 on eligible purchases made July through December, for a maximum of $500 per calendar year. Eligible purchases are defined as American Airlines Vacations travel packages or Experiences purchased via aavacations.com.2
